summary: Iter-63 · Phase 4 P1 COMPLETION validation gate. Backend unit tests 48/48 green (tests/test_cem_and_recursive_pipeline.py + test_correlation_engine.py + test_elf_analyzer.py + test_office_analyzer.py + test_pe_analyzer.py + test_artifact_intelligence.py). New E2E suite (10/10 green) against the preview URL exercises: (1) GET /api/correlations/cem/{case_id} — shape (cem_version, artifact_id, convergence, canonical_artifacts, events, indicators, mitre, traces, child_artifacts, verdict), every event carries provenance, and the endpoint is DETERMINISTIC across repeated calls (same version, same events order, same indicators); (2) POST /api/correlations/find-related — returns existing_investigation for cases already inside an investigation (seed case 6a71df55de61c45467e3a650 → SEED_CID 6a72169b3d98eb14810c9506), suggestions array + count + source ∈ {cache,live} + min_score=50; refresh=true forces source='live'; 404 for unknown case; (3) Post-record hook — after /api/decode/smart records a case, the case doc gains BOTH `cem` and `pending_correlations` fields within ~10 seconds; (4) Regression on /api/correlations/{cid}/{chain,graph,timeline,summary,suggestions} + /api/decode/smart text path + /api/artifacts/capabilities (all four analyzers still declared). Frontend UI: admin login → HISTORY page → click actions kebab on a row → 'FIND RELATED' menu item present with testid `btn-find-related-{case_id}` → clicking opens FindRelatedDrawer overlay with all expected testids: `find-related-create` (button for non-correlated case), `find-related-empty` (friendly empty-state copy 'No cases in your history share deterministic evidence with this one — no matching hashes, URLs, C2 indicators, or MITRE technique overlap above the confidence threshold.'), `find-related-refresh` (works, forces live scan), `find-related-close` (closes drawer). Cross-Case Suggestions header shows count · source · min score 50. INVESTIGATION detail page /investigations/6a72169b3d98eb14810c9506 renders threat summary card (SUSPICIOUS · RISK 55, 4 stat tiles, MITRE chips), Attack Chain / Evidence Graph / Timeline tabs, Auto-Correlation Suggestions right panel, Metadata sidebar, DELETE button. Overlap-bug (iter-62 design note) is FIXED — at 1180px viewport the main content column no longer bleeds into the suggestions aside (visible in iter63_investigation_small_viewport.png).
critical_code_review_comments: cem.py / recursive_child_pipeline.py — 13 unit tests all green locally; CEM output is deterministic (verified with repeat calls returning identical version+event order+indicators).

routers/correlations.py — /find-related properly branches on refresh flag (cache vs live) and returns min_score=50; /cem falls back to fresh emit_cem() when case.cem is missing (backward-compatible with pre-hook records).

routers/history.py — _post_record_investigation_hook fires as create_task (non-blocking), emits CEM, runs scan_correlations (top-5 cached on case.pending_correlations), and bumps parent correlation.updated_at when correlation_id is present. Each step is try/except-guarded — decode latency is preserved.

FindRelatedDrawer.jsx — all promised testids present and wired (existing/create/empty/refresh/close). Refresh forces live re-scan (source flips from 'cached' to 'live scan'). Close testid works; outside-click also dismisses (design note: verified via close testid).
InvestigationDetailPage.jsx — overlap bug (iter-62) fixed via minWidth:0 on main column; verified at 1180px viewport.

Master architecture contracts preserved: Analyzers still declare children only (recursive pipeline processes them in a bounded loop); CEM is emitted only after convergence; correlation engine consumes CEM/canonical artifacts.
Preview URL is intermittently idle-timeout-prone (already documented in iter-61/62). A single `supervisorctl restart backend && sleep ~25s` recovered it; all 10 E2E tests then ran cleanly in 15.6s.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all promised testids verified, drawer flow works, overlap bug fixed)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing correlation 6a72169b3d98eb14810c9506 and seed cases 6a71df55de61c45467e3a650 (PE) + 6a7208be7b3dd2412874045f (ELF). Post-record hook test creates a marker case via /api/decode/smart and deletes it on teardown, so DB stays clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter63_cem_and_find_related_e2e.py is self-cleaning and safe as a regression suite. If the preview URL returns 502 or a 30s ReadTimeout on the FIRST call, run `sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 25` — this is a documented idle-sleep quirk. Note: /api/history recorded cases store the input under `input_preview` (truncated), not `input_text` — reuse the same match pattern if you need to correlate a recorded case back to its source. The UI 'existing_investigation' branch of FindRelatedDrawer was verified via API (test_find_related_existing_investigation) rather than UI because the correlated seed cases fall below the currently-paginated top-100 rows on /history; if you need UI proof, seed a fresher correlated case at the top of history first.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four completion components (CEM boundary, Recursive Child Pipeline, auto-scan-on-record, Find Related Cases) validated green. Only friction was the preview URL idle-timeout, which is a known infra behavior, not a code issue.
